name: Big Bob: Awakening
summary:
Ever wanted to be a REALLY fat monkey? Well now's you chance with BIG BOB: AWAKENING! (Horror of the hit game Big Bob Tag)

This is a game that is being worked on that will allow players to become the biggest monkeys they have ever been!

"Big Bob: Awakening" is a VR horror game where you play as fat monkeys who need to survive in a dark, creepy world. The game utilizes gtag style movement to climb, swing, and run through the scary environments while something is chasing you.
